name: National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930
what: Call as soon as money has left your account. The first hour matters most.
when: You paid or shared an OTP because of a scam.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
what: File the full complaint online after you have called 1930.
when: You need a written complaint for your bank or the police.

name: Chakshu on Sanchar Saathi
what: Report a suspicious call, SMS or WhatsApp message to the telecom department.
when: A message or call looks like fraud but you have not lost money.

name: Sanchar Saathi
what: Block a lost or stolen phone and check which mobile connections are in your name.
when: Your phone is lost, or you suspect a SIM you did not take.

name: RBI Sachet
what: Report an illegal deposit or investment scheme to the Reserve Bank.
when: Someone promises very high returns or collects deposits without a licence.
